title: Susan McCasland's 911 call about her husband
summary: Susan McCasland tells of Susan McCasland's 911 call about her husband, about 2026 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have some indication that he must have planned not to be found.

plain: Susan McCasland, whose husband went missing in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in 2026, made a call to 911, the US emergency phone line. On the recording she says she has some sign that he must have planned not to be found. Her account is told as part of a wider story about American scientists going missing.
